lines.1: So this was the power of childhood friendship.
lines.2: 「Anyway, why the hell have you been completely out of touch?」
lines.4: 「Always fussing over everybody else... Why did you disappear on us?」
lines.7: 「Oh, right. I'm transferring to Yuihama Academy. I've been dealing with the paperwork.」
lines.12: 「Hey, this is the first I've heard about any of that!」
lines.13: 「That's because this is the first time I've said it.」
lines.14: 「Yuihama... The Shonan school known as the king of track and field.」
lines.16: 「I've decided to put everything into track.」
lines.20: 「Whoa, they scouted you? That's Subaru for you. Impressive work from my own underling.」
lines.21: 「I'm neither your underling nor your friend.」
lines.23: 「Why keep it secret? You could've told us.」
lines.29: Because Kinu and I got together?
lines.31: She looked back and forth between Subaru and me.
lines.32: Kinu seemed to sense it too.
lines.34: 「When do you leave? At the start of the second term?」
lines.35: 「No. Today. I've already got a room in the dorm.」
lines.36: 「What? There is not even time for a farewell party?」
lines.37: 「Whoa, whoa, whoa! Isn't this way too sudden?」
lines.42: 「W-well, you'll come back here on weekends and stuff, right?」
lines.43: 「I won't be back for a while.」
lines.46: 「I'm thrilled to get away from that garbage old man too.」
lines.47: With that, Subaru left the room.
lines.49: 「Yeah. I only came to say goodbye.」
lines.52: 「There's one thing... I absolutely have to say.」
lines.53: 「You called our late-night talks a pointless gathering, right?」
lines.57: 「Talking with them put my heart at ease.」
lines.60: 「Your voices were sometimes noise to me. I will not apologize for saying so.」
lines.61: 「However... I have learned firsthand that something trivial to one person may matter more than anything to another.」
lines.62: 「I will choose my words more carefully from now on.」
lines.63: 「...No, I'm sorry too. I shouldn't keep whining about the past. I just needed to say that much.」
lines.64: 「Oh, and look after those idiots for me.」
lines.67: 「People might call them idiots, but they're good people. They really are.」
lines.71: 「Oww! You slapped me as hard as you could on the back--」
lines.73: 「...Ha ha. Spoken like a true athlete.」
lines.74: 「That fired me right up. I'll give it my best.」
lines.77: 「Still acting all casual at a time like this...」
lines.78: 「I've never been good with teary goodbyes.」
lines.81: 「I know this is kind of a weird time to ask, but...」
lines.82: 「Can I ask why you fell for me?」
lines.84: 「Honestly, the more I think about it, the less sense it makes.」
lines.86: 「Grr. What's with that look? It's pissing me off.」
lines.87: 「Ask Leo one more time why he fell for you. My answer's the same.」
lines.88: 「Every woman but you only left me empty.」
lines.95: 「When... When will I see you again?」
lines.96: 「I dunno. When I make the Olympics, maybe. Once I do, we'll be able to meet again.」
lines.97: 「Friends should be equals, right? So I've got to earn something worthy of you.」
lines.98: 「(Hey, doesn't that mean they'll never meet again?)」
lines.99: 「(Not if he's going to Yuihama. He might seriously make it.)」
lines.103: 「Yeah. I'm done soaking in lukewarm water.」
lines.104: 「Truth is, when they first scouted me, I really wanted to go.」
lines.105: 「But I had... a comfortable place here.」
lines.106: 「You smashed it up and gave me the push I needed. Now I can finally stand at the starting line.」
lines.108: 「So quit looking miserable. This is my decision.」
lines.109: 「The last of the Five Rules. I said it was easy, remember?」
lines.111: 「No. Though that's important too. Don't forget that one either.」
lines.113: 「Right. That one. Told you it was easy.」
lines.114: 「Just keep smiling like you always do. That's all I want.」
lines.115: 「Isn't that kind of insulting in its own way?!」
lines.117: 「Fukahire, you can have every book in my room.」
lines.118: 「Come on, I can't celebrate that in a scene like this.」
lines.119: 「I mean, I'll take responsibility for them, but...」
lines.120: 「...You'll go far. I'm rooting for you.」
lines.121: 「Well, see you. Leo, take care of Crab.」
lines.125: Why did it have to be so sudden...?
lines.129: 「Your best friend is setting out. See him off properly.」
lines.131: 「I do not know what troubles you about Date.」
lines.132: 「But it is past time you stopped depending on him.」
lines.133: 「He has his own path to follow.」
lines.135: Kinu and I would be a couple, while Subaru and Fukahire remained my friends.
lines.136: I had clung to that selfish fantasy.
lines.138: This was the path he had chosen.
lines.139: I raised my head and watched his back.
lines.142: I didn't believe this would destroy what we had.
lines.143: Then I wouldn't let our parting stay vague. One more time--
lines.146: I shouted after his shrinking figure.
lines.147: I knew he could hear me.
lines.148: You asked me to take care of Kinu, and I will.
lines.149: We're going to be insanely happy.
lines.152: Subaru walked down the dark road.
